AutoPM is a modern and minimal project management app that lets AI create your tasks. It uses Google Gemini AI to automate the tasks of a project manager. 
No need to waste time in creating tasks and tickets on a complex Project management software, let AI create tasks for you in seconds!ff

quotes.text:
Hey fellow hackers,
I love to use Jira. But honestly small scale startups are too high paced to create ticket for every task.
- Jira is very new to interns and they find it hard to adopt
- Startups find it easier to just send you a Slack messsage on your next weeks task
- Early stage startups dont have project managers who would spend tens of hours every week to create task tickets and track them

So I created AutoPM. A free and minimal project management software that generates task in seconds.
You can generate tasks by either copy pasting the list of tasks sent to you by your manager or give it a prompt like ChatGPT.
